question_text: Was the Example City water portal outage a hack?
answer_text: Not shown by any public source. The utility says a failed software update caused the outage and that it found no sign of an intrusion.
label: Unverified

question_text: Did ransomware lock the billing system?
answer_text: No. The utility said no systems were encrypted, and the claim came from one anonymous post.
label: Debunked

what_would_settle_it: A statement from the utility or its regulator on whether any data was accessed.
